Later, dude.

Any kind of oil will do.
I guess not.
Any restaurants nearby?
Maybe I could MAKE some vinegar.
Maybe some Krugerrands?
Maybe a gold watch?
Maybe not, eh?

Far out.
As if.
Way.
Gnarly.
Awesome.
All's you need is an eyepatch and a hook.

Avast, me matey!
Totally rad!
Wendell Finkwinkle is awesome as the Guybrush dude.
Killer three-headed monkey effect, man.
Heh heh heh.
Yo ho ho, dude.
Prepare to walk the plank, me bucko.
Stand back, ye scurvy sea dog.
Stop yer starin' and pass the grog.

Make haste, three sheets to the wind.
Does a point always go forwards, or a flat part?

Personally, I'd wear the point forwards^
Personally, I'd wear the flat part forwards^
^that way, you never forget which direction you're walking.

Of course, they'd probably eat roaches anyhow.

Know where I could get them a couple hats, extra big?
They're like that.
Maybe with a little chocolate sauce.
I once saw them play a whole set with grasshoppers in \254\008     their nostrils.
Ever hear of them?
They play funk punk folk polka house grunge rock.
I helped name the band!
No, I guess you wouldn't have.
If you ever get to the 1990's, check them out.
They play at the Black and Blue Sound Pitt in the city a lot.
That's a new movement based in Tucson.

I thought of the `Spittoon` part.

I worked with them before I hooked up with Megabreth.
Are there several manufacturers?
Would I need to go to a specialty store?
Do they come in a variety of designer colors?
I'm interested in quality.
Could I get a band logo printed on one?
Does anyone make them with propellers on top?
I don't suppose you'd consider parting with yours, would you?
Well, let me know if you change your mind.
Black is good, but how about red?
Maybe like a gold lam or something.
I'd really go for a paisley print.
Then again, I guess red wouldn't go over too big here at the moment.
Hello, my silent gauze-wrapped friend.
I've powered up the Chron-O-John.
I've got to get power to my Chron-O-John.
There's something else about the human show^
I'm concerned about the human show.
Do you think it's strange, me talking to a mummy?
My, those are nice clothes you're wearing.
I really should go now.
I hope Bernard and Hoagie get ready soon, so I can go \254\008     home.
I guess this is more or less goodbye.
I wish I could take you back with me.
You've been a great friend.
Thanks for never complaining about anything.
I just want to say you look great in spaghetti.
But your wardrobe wouldn't go over well.
But I'm afraid of what my friends would say.
But that might mess up the space/time continuum.
Call me sometime, OK?
I mean, you not being able to talk back and so forth.
It's not so different from talking to specimens at med \254\008     school.
It's not so different from talking to guys at med school.
Oh well.
Actually, I kind of like that in a guy.

You, ah, CAN'T talk, right?
Except that they're usually a bit more open^
Except that you're a little older^
Except most of them aren't quite all there^
Except for the bandages^
Except you probably know more than most of them^
Except even you dress better than they do^
All that white really gets to me.
My grandmother has a couch covered in that material.
Is that what the well-dressed Egyptian wore?
How am I going to get you downstairs with the others?
Your smile isn't much to look at.
We've got to do something about your hair.
We've still got to do something about your hair.
I guess we can't do much about your sense of humor.
I think this guy next to you might be a problem.
The froofy guy next to you is definitely a problem.
We gotta do something about this Harold guy or we're sunk.
Where am I going to find a human to enter?
Is it really MORAL?
What do you think they do with the humans afterwards?
But I really should go now.
Most of the humans are probably entered already.
